stem.text: Two identical waves are produced by sources at points P and Q. The waves travel along different paths to reach point R, as shown.

stem.alt: Points P and Q, each with a dot, and point R at the upper right. An arrow from P points right along a dashed line of 80 cm to R, and an arrow from Q points up and to the right along a dashed line of 100 cm to R.

stem.text: Both waves have a wavelength of $6.0\,\text{cm}$. The waves are in phase at point R.
What is the phase difference between the waves as they leave points P and Q?
